title: Release P007 C02 locator-bore depth and coupled P003 pilot-length non-bottoming stack
scope: K01-P-007 C02 axial locator depth and coupled K01-P-003 J2 pilot length; no native geometry change

decision.P007_C02_release_spec: Ø14.10 H7 locator bore; depth 2.00 ±0.05 mm from Datum-A mating plane
decision.P003_counterpart_release_spec: Ø14.10 g6 pilot; axial pilot length 1.50 ±0.05 mm from P003 mating plane
decision.axial_location: Metal mating faces remain the axial locating surfaces; the pilot shall not bottom.
decision.inspection: P007 depth by CMM/depth measurement from Datum-A mating plane to locator-bore back face; P003 pilot length by CMM/height/depth measurement from its mating plane. First article confirms capability before P6.

basis: EDR-024 fixed current canonical P007 locator depth at 2.00 mm and P003 pilot nominal length at 1.50 mm but intentionally left variation OPEN.
REQ-K01-J2-LOC-001 requires radial location by the Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot/locator pair and axial location by the metal mating faces, so positive non-bottoming clearance is a functional requirement.
P007 monolithic machining route is selected by EDR-025. The 2 mm locator depth is a short flange/locator machining characteristic, not the 0.30 mm thin-wall capability-limited deep-bore surface.

The project already controls comparable axial machined dimensions C05 flange thickness and C06 OAL at ±0.05 mm under standard precision inspection context; the same bounded axial capability class is used for this coupled J2 stack, with first-article confirmation retained.
P003 and P007 production materials are both AISI 316L / EN 1.4404, so common-temperature expansion does not erode the positive clearance sign for the coupled same-material stack.

technical_filter.function: Prevents P003 pilot bottoming so metal mating faces remain the only axial locator while retaining 1.50 mm nominal radial-locator engagement.
technical_filter.tolerance_stack: 0.40 mm minimum bottom clearance and 0.60 mm maximum bottom clearance at dimensional limits.
technical_filter.manufacturing: ±0.05 mm is treated as a standard-precision axial machining requirement for the short locator/pilot features; first-article capability remains mandatory rather than inferred.
technical_filter.inspection: Direct axial measurements from each part's functional mating plane; measurement setup shall be non-distorting.
technical_filter.assembly_service: No axial preload is transferred through the pilot bottom; mating faces seat first by design.
technical_filter.change_impact: K01-D-006 C02 changes from 2.00 NOM to 2.00 ±0.05. K01-D-003/P003 must later project 1.50 ±0.05; D003 becomes semantically stale but is not current WIP.
technical_filter.concept_preservation: No native geometry changes; only variation semantics are closed.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Not a manufacturing acceptance criterion; leaves the non-bottoming stack formally open.
Would hide a functional J2 stack inside a non-functional default and violate the project rule against uncontrolled general tolerances.
Unnecessary geometry/process change; current 0.50 mm nominal clearance is already sufficient once bounded tolerances are assigned.

stale_triggers: P003 pilot nominal length changes from 1.50 mm
P007 locator depth nominal changes from 2.00 mm
axial location changes away from the metal mating faces
supplier/FAI demonstrates inability to hold ±0.05 mm on either coupled axial feature
